title: Verified regional map additions & offshore province associations
scope: Evidence-backed Batam data centres, East Java / Bali offshore PSCs, Tangguh, Abadi Masela in Maluku and Natuna
methodology: Use explicit provinces arrays for offshore multi-province contract associations; no fixed facility pin is inferred. Recorded corporate plans, agreements, FIDs, exploration, production and government groundbreaking have separate meanings. Vintage and parent overlaps are disclosed. Monetary values are never summed across parent and sub-records.
